# MOXAND Security Services

> MOXAND Security Services provides unarmed security guards, event security, mobile patrol, fire watch, remote video surveillance, and virtual guard services across Virginia. MOXAND Security Services is a DBA of M Secura LLC, licensed by the Virginia Department of Criminal Justice Services (DCJS), license No. 11-30334, and insured.

- Phone: (571) 596-7770
- Email: info@moxand.com
- Service area: the entire state of Virginia, including Northern Virginia (Fairfax, Arlington, Alexandria, Loudoun, Prince William), Richmond, Virginia Beach and Hampton Roads, Fredericksburg, and the Shenandoah Valley.
- Pricing: quoted per job; every site is different. Request a quote online or by phone.

## Services

- [Security guard services](https://moxand.com/guards.html): unarmed security guards, mobile patrol, and fire watch for businesses, properties, and construction sites.
- [Event security](https://moxand.com/events.html): unarmed security for public and private events.
- [Remote surveillance and virtual guards](https://moxand.com/monitoring): live camera monitoring, virtual guards, voice warnings, and alarm response.
